intro.zh-CN: 按 2026 年 9 月 8 日的验收序列整理数量变化。最终 A／B 库位为 3／4 箱，总库存 7 箱，由记录确认。
intro.en: Quantities below follow the acceptance sequence dated September 8, 2026. The recorded final result is 3 cartons in A, 4 in B and 7 in total.

note.zh-CN: 云端记录另确认：四次并发提交相同请求不重复记账，库存不足被拒绝，作废请求不能再次提交。这里展示历史虚拟测试，未重新运行原系统。
note.en: The cloud record also confirms that four concurrent identical requests do not double-count, insufficient stock is rejected and a cancelled request cannot commit. This is historical virtual-test evidence, not a new system test.

intro.en: In a test record dated September 23, 2026, a product variant had 1 unit on the books and 0 counted. Three results were cross-checked after submission.

zh-CN: 从 1 件扣减为 0 件

note.zh-CN: 这是历史盘亏样例，不代表所有业务组合均通过。同期九项复查为八项具体样例通过、一项发现问题；此处不据旧记录判断系统当前状态。
note.en: This historical shortage example does not establish acceptance of every workflow. The same review recorded eight passing examples and one issue across nine checks; it does not determine the current system state.

zh-CN.question: 申请售后需要提供哪些信息？
zh-CN.answer: 示意资料要求提供产品型号、问题描述和购买凭证，未规定处理时限，因此不能承诺解决时间。
zh-CN.source_label: 示意资料 A（AI 拟写）
zh-CN.excerpt: “售后咨询需提供产品型号、问题描述及购买凭证。客服核对信息后跟进。本条资料未规定处理时限。”

zh-CN.question: 这个型号的滤芯能去除铅吗？
zh-CN.answer: 示意资料没有该型号的污染物测试结果，不能确认。需核对对应检测报告或转人工客服，不能从其他型号推断。
zh-CN.source_label: 示意资料 B（AI 拟写）
zh-CN.excerpt: “本条资料介绍安装方式与配件清单，不包含污染物去除测试结果。”

en.question: What information should I provide for after-sales support?
en.answer: The illustrative source asks for the model, problem description and proof of purchase. It sets no deadline, so a resolution time cannot be promised.
en.excerpt: “For after-sales enquiries, provide the product model, a description of the problem and proof of purchase. Support follows up after checking the information. This material sets no handling deadline.”

en.question: Does this cartridge model remove lead?
en.answer: The illustrative source has no contaminant test result for this model. Check its report or refer to human support; do not infer performance from another model.
en.excerpt: “This material describes installation and the accessory list. It contains no contaminant-removal test results.”
